interpretation_guardrail: The union is a review surface, not an automatic word mask. Fewer components or more recovered pixels is not inherently better. Temporary grouping changes labels only and can never create final ink pixels.

findings.acknowledgement-tight: The darkened source makes the line substantially easier to inspect. Two automatic 10-pixel projection valleys at x 68-78 and 279-289 separate the clipped left fragment, the short middle word/punctuation, and the long main word. Valley-bounded grouping yields 10 groups and reduces the largest width fraction from 0.6267 to 0.5933 without changing ink pixels.
findings.enough-tight: The one-pass Eynollah core contains only 2188 pixels and visibly misses most of the faint center. The composed review surface contains 9695 exact source pixels. One 17-pixel projection valley at x 141-158 prevents the left neighbor from joining the recovered target; the largest group width falls from 0.9483 to 0.6950 while exact pixels remain unchanged.
findings.folded-write-to-you: The composition recovers visible faint tail fragments, but the fixed valley rule finds no trustworthy word gap. It leaves 21 balanced groups instead of forcing a merge; this crop requires rough Kraken/word geometry or human/agent ownership assistance.

post_run_visual_review.limitations: All three crops are on one acting-safe page. Dark/vector and paper masks are software probes rather than truth. The union includes exploratory evidence and is not safe for automatic ownership. The result validates composition and abstention behavior, not corpus-wide accuracy.
post_run_visual_review.second_pass_eynollah_role: Keep enhanced Eynollah reinference as an optional measured challenger. On enough it regularized the source-only candidate to 9529 p0.50 pixels in 38 components, but the one-pass composition recovers comparable visible structure without another model call and retains tier provenance. Do not require iterative Eynollah in the default pipeline.

selection_rule: Run no new model inference. Reuse one frozen full-page Eynollah probability as core/noise teacher; combine conservative source recovery with positive-unknown page-ink vector evidence gated by measured darkening and ridge response; preserve lower-confidence vector evidence as an exploratory tier; group exact pixels with three previously frozen anisotropic kernels. Also challenge global balanced grouping with a predeclared projection-valley rule: Gaussian sigma 5, lowest 10% smoothed column density, minimum 10-pixel interior valley, and no grouping across the valley midpoint.
